scope: Stage 12 — Metal Gear Solid (1998), Shadow Moses REX encounter; source Jack 2003 ammunition in Tactics

claims: Original Metal Gear Solid identity; character/story archive.

sources.type: Konami MGS1 Screenplay Book / Story Compendium, archival OCR
claims: Stinger target is the radome on REX left arm; armored exterior is not the defeat target.
Gray Fox fires a laser at the radome sensors; the cockpit opens for manual control.
Stinger missiles into the open cockpit destroy the computer control system.
Gray Fox brings Stinger missiles during the transition.
Liquid survives disabled REX and later fights Solid Snake atop it.
sources.limitations: The compendium includes working screenplay material and is not alone a certification of every final-game animation or timing. The encounter order is corroborated by the original-game walkthrough.

sources.type: Matthew Reynolds / Crazyreyn original PlayStation FAQ, version 1.0 (2007)
claims: First target is radome with Stinger; second target is exposed central cockpit.
Liquid Snake fistfight follows REX disablement.
sources.limitations: Fan-authored gameplay guide, not an official numerical balance specification.

sources.type: Original PlayStation walkthrough, Underground Base Cave
claims: Ninja intervention between two REX targets; chaff/radar dependence ends in manual cockpit phase.
sources.limitations: Legacy guide with transcription errors; cross-checked with compendium and the other guide.

implemented: Two playable target pools: radome first, then open cockpit after summarized Gray Fox assistance.
Source Stinger mission targeting uses actual hero turn, reachable-cell movement, target-cell click, two-to-six-cell profile and line of sight.
Body HP template is preserved at 720; ordinary attacks, external items, field supers, anomalies, infection and hazards cannot replace the weak-point sequence.
Overflow cannot spill from radome into cockpit; actual target HP loss is counted and used for lifedrain.
Completion disables REX; Liquid survives, and living Genome Soldiers do not block the encounter result.
Exact stage mode/incarnation/universe/exclusive-roster/canonical boss guards; custom stages and other incarnations are excluded.

Jack 2003 Tactics pistol has one shot per new battle, only spent on a legal hit; depleted actions are rejected before cooldown, charge and turn costs; other actions and ordinary profiles remain available.
Custom enemy Jack reserves are separate from player reserves.
adaptations: Existing 720 boss HP are split into 360 radome and 360 cockpit points. These are game balance values, not original-game source values.
Shared Stinger supply, repeated availability to a crossover squad, a stationary one-cell target, a two-cell minimum range, damage values and tactical turn timing are adaptations.
Gray Fox laser assistance and supply are represented at the phase transition; his death cinematic and movement are not replayed.
Three baseline Genome Soldiers remain an adapted arena composition; they do not participate in the original REX duel.
REX weapon AI remains the existing railgun-based tactical attack; full source machine-gun, missile, laser and stomp patterns are not reproduced.
The later Liquid fistfight, escape sequence and source camera geometry are not included in this mission.
Jack reserve renewal is per new crossover battle, not a claim of repeated shots within the source film story.

validation.naturalAiSquad: Same authored squad and stats; legal AI route; only animation scheduling removed in deterministic scenario tests.

realTimerCheck.modifications: No overrides of source statistics, HP, ATB, positions, actor cooldowns or engine scheduling.
